headword.description: The dictionary form of the term, in the term's own language.

pronunciation.description: The pronunciation in IPA between slashes, or the reading for a script that needs one, such as kana or pinyin. An empty string when neither applies.

contextMeaning.description: What the term means in the given passage, in one or two sentences written in the reader's language. An empty string when no passage was given.

senses.description: Up to five senses, grouped by part of speech, most common first. Always includes the sense used in the passage.

partOfSpeech.description: The part of speech, named in the reader's language.

meaning.description: A short equivalent or definition in the reader's language.

inContext.description: True for the sense the term has in the given passage, false otherwise.

example.description: A short example of this sense, in the term's own language.

exampleTranslation.description: The example translated into the reader's language.
